errors.repo_url_not_a_repository: repo_url does not name a repository (want https://<github>/<owner>/<repo>)
errors.init_revision_invalid: revision {rev:%q} must be a positive integer
errors.upload_multipart: the upload must be a multipart/form-data body
errors.upload_meta_first: the first part of the upload must be "meta", the project's fields as JSON
errors.upload_archive_missing: the upload has no "archive" part with the folder
errors.upload_read: the upload was cut off before it finished
errors.reupload_mode: mode {mode} is not one of merge or replace
errors.main_moved: the default branch moved since the folder was downloaded
errors.reupload_conflict: the folder clashes with what changed on the default branch

hints.pre_launch_hooks: Script that runs inside the task's copy before the agent starts. What it prints and its exit code are added to the agent's prompt.
hints.stage_prompts: Text added to the agent's prompt when it works in that stage on this project.

log.revoke_project_grants: revoke credential grants for deleted project {project}
log.archive_stream: send the zip of project {project}, branch {branch}
log.task_branches: list the task branches of project {project}

audit.init_script_saved: Init script of {project} saved as revision {revision}
audit.init_script_restored: Init script of {project} restored from revision {from} as revision {revision}
